en-us.Mall_Cinema_Begin_initial: The lobby announcement calls this showing's audience inside. Beyond the ticket check, signs point to the two screens, where the lights are dimming.
en-us.Mall_Cinema_Begin_join: $joining.name$ catches this showing. The signs beside the ticket check are still lit; seats for watching the movie await inside.
en-us.Mall_Cinema_Begin_late: The movie has already started when $joining.name$ arrives. Muted dialogue comes through the screen doors. Best to step quietly inside.
